goalZh: 会在校医院说清楚哪里不舒服、从什么时候开始,听懂医生的简单嘱咐
canDoZh: 能在学校医务室告诉医生自己哪里不舒服、什么时候开始的,并听懂怎么吃药

newItems.noteZh: 比 I'm sick. 委婉;这里的 well 是"身体好"。
美式 I'm sick. 就是"我病了";英式的 sick 常指"想吐"。
I have a headache. 我头疼;重音在前 HEAD-ache,ache 读 /eɪk/,ch 读 /k/。
have a fever 发烧;美国体温用华氏度,100°F 约等于 37.8°C。
have a sore throat 嗓子疼;throat 是清音 th /θ/ 再接 r,舌尖从齿间迅速往后卷。
这里的 cold 是名词“感冒”,要带 a:I have a cold. / You have a cold.(不说 I have cold);形容词 cold 是“冷的”。
看医生 see a doctor;称呼医生 Dr. + 姓。
吃药说 take medicine,不说 eat medicine!
Get some rest. 好好休息;r 开头嘴唇先收圆。
一次 once、两次 twice、三次以上用 times:three times a day。
You're going to get better. 你会好起来的;朋友生病时口语也常说 Feel better!

lines.speaker: receptionist
lines.text: Hi! How can I help you?
lines.zh: 你好!有什么可以帮你的?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I don't feel well. I need to see a doctor.
lines.zh: 我不太舒服,想看一下医生。

lines.speaker: doctor
lines.text: Hi, Lei. So you're sick? What's wrong?
lines.zh: 你好,磊。你病了?哪儿不舒服?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I have a headache, a sore throat, and a fever.

lines.speaker: doctor
lines.text: When did it start? Did you take any medicine?
lines.zh: 什么时候开始的?吃过药了吗?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Yesterday. No, I didn't. I was tired, so I slept all day.
lines.zh: 昨天开始的。没吃药。我很累,就睡了一整天。

lines.speaker: doctor
lines.text: You have a cold. Drink a lot of water and get some rest.
lines.zh: 你感冒了。多喝水,好好休息。

lines.speaker: doctor
lines.text: Take this medicine twice a day. You're going to get better.
lines.zh: 这个药一天吃两次。你会好起来的。

questions.explainZh: I have a headache, a sore throat, and a fever.
Take this medicine twice a day.(twice = 两次)

grammar.titleZh: 看病常用:have a + 症状、过去的问答、医嘱
grammar.bodyZh: 说症状用 have a + 名词:I have a headache(头疼)/ a sore throat(嗓子疼)/ a fever(发烧),别漏掉 a。感冒也是这个说法:You have a cold.(你感冒了),这里的 cold 是名词"感冒",不是"冷的"。医生问过去的情况用 did:When did it start? Did you take any medicine? 简短回答 Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.(问的是过去,不说 No, I don't.)。医嘱多用祈使句,直接用动词原形开头:Drink a lot of water. Get some rest. Take this medicine twice a day.。"吃药"说 take medicine,不说 eat medicine。发音:headache 重音在前 HEAD-ache,ache 读 /eɪk/;throat 开头是清音 /θ/,舌尖先放在齿间,再迅速往后卷成 r。

examples.text: I have a headache and a sore throat.
Did you take any medicine? — No, I didn't.
